keyPoints: ["Internal fertilization occurs inside the female body; humans are an example.","External fertilization occurs outside the female body, commonly in aquatic animals such as fish and amphibians.","The two modes differ in offspring number, survival rate, and parental care."]
modelAnswer: Internal fertilization occurs inside the female body, such as in humans, while external fertilization occurs outside the female body, usually in water, such as in fish and amphibians. Internal fertilization generally involves fewer offspring with higher survival and more parental care; external fertilization generally involves many offspring with lower survival and less parental care.

stem: Briefly rationalize parthenogenesis as a type of asexual reproduction. Give one example.
keyPoints: ["An unfertilized egg develops into a new individual.","No fertilization occurs, so it is asexual reproduction.","Some insects, including bees, provide examples."]
modelAnswer: Parthenogenesis is a form of reproduction in which an unfertilized egg develops into a new individual, so it is asexual reproduction because no sperm fertilizes the egg. One example is parthenogenesis in some insects, such as bees.
